objective: Give every stored AI cover a unique file name so a cleared attempt never collides with an earlier image.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Change only store() in src/lib/ai-cover-backend.ts (shown) exactly as the acceptance test header says: upload to coverObjectPath(owner, item, id) with "-<dependencies.now()>" inserted before ".png", and return that path. Private storage refuses overwrites (upsert: false), so the old fixed name made a re-attempt fail after a paid image was generated.
Keep every other behaviour of the backend unchanged. One small anchored edit.
The previous backend acceptance test is retired by this contract (superseded_acceptance_tests) and replaced by the acceptance test below, identical except for the stored path.
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks, together with the existing ai-cover acceptance tests; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
source_manifest_note: Computed by the coding assistant from a separate read-only clone with both the Factory reader and the owner's standalone script (124 files); the Factory fetch verifies it independently before use.
